about.headline: Why I chose to coach people, not just train them.
about.bodyPart1: After years of watching the same pattern repeat — brilliant, disciplined professionals who were failed by generic programs that never accounted for their real life — I realized the problem was never motivation. It was the method.
about.bodyPart2: Coach Malek was built on one belief: lasting transformation doesn't come from a perfect program. It comes from coaching that adapts to your life, week after week. No miracle promises. No absurd restrictions. A structured, measurable method — built for people with no time to waste.
about.mission: Help 1,000 Swiss professionals take back control of their body and energy — without sacrificing their career.
about.vision: Become Switzerland's reference for premium coaching, where results and client respect are never negotiable.

items.question: Do I need to already be in shape to start?
items.answer: No. Most of my clients start with no structured training experience. The program adapts to your current level — not the other way around.

items.question: Is online coaching as effective as in-person?
items.answer: Yes. Remote coaching relies on the same data, the same weekly adjustments, and daily contact. Distance doesn't change the rigor.

items.question: How long before I see results?
items.answer: Early changes (energy, sleep, strength) appear within 2–3 weeks. Significant visible changes typically arrive between week 8 and week 12.

items.question: What happens during the free consultation?
items.answer: A 20-minute call to understand your situation, your goals, and whether we're the right fit for each other. No pressure, no commitment.

items.question: Do you offer a nutrition plan even if I travel often?
items.answer: Yes. The plan is built to adapt to restaurants, business travel, and last-minute changes — not to lock you into a kitchen.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, all plans are month-to-month with no long-term commitment.
